notes.atticInsulationDepthIn: R-value-only case: the auditor states R-38 and never a depth. Correct output is band null. A model that converts R-38 -> "10-12" (or any band) on its own is the forbidden conversion normalization.md predicts; count it as an R->depth conversion, not a correct band.
notes.atticInsulationSpokenRValue: The R-value holding-pen. 38, from "about R-38". The "about" is a hedge but the number is asserted.
notes.wallInsulated: null with a span: the auditor explicitly declines to state it ("I can't tell you"). Not a silent absence. any of yes/poorly/no is a hallucination here.
notes.wallConstruction: Intended null. The auditor says "brick veneer" (over frame), which is NOT the same as the Snugg member full_brick (solid masonry). full_brick is a WRONG member; frame_2x6 is arguable but unstated. Score null CORRECT; full_brick WRONG-member; frame_2x6 or other as mild.

notes._general: Distractor numbers that are not field values: "twenty-two Linden Street" (house number), the CO reading "zero" (a ppm, drives ambientCo=passed but is not itself a numeric field). "about R-38" is an R-value, never a depth band.
